historyRule: All shipped versions, tags, releases and evidence through v18.9.1 remain immutable and retain their historical naming.

productVersion.patch: Backward-compatible bug, security or reliability corrections.

workSlice.rule: A workSliceId is an independently traceable engineering packet and does not consume a public product version by itself. Multiple completed work slices may be grouped into one public Stable version.

buildIdentity.buildId: Immutable build/evidence identity independent of product compatibility version.
buildIdentity.platformBuildNumber: Positive decimal integer, globally monotonic across newly published runnable builds and independent of SemVer components.

evidenceIdentity.evidenceSchemaVersion: Version of the evidence contract, independent of product and build versions.

nextReleaseGroupingRule: After ADAPT-CI-CONVERGENCE-001 closes and the product backlog is re-baselined, backward-compatible feature work normally groups into a MINOR release; urgent corrective-only work may use PATCH.
